versions.changelog: Examples switched from the JS SDK to the wavespeed CLI (with the @wavespeed/mcp server as the MCP alternative): install + login setup, @path local-file upload, price quotes, --json output. SDK-specific sections (sync mode, custom client, runNoThrow) removed.

WaveSpeed Nano Banana 2 skill initial release:

- Generate and edit images using Google's Nano Banana 2 model via WaveSpeed AI.
- Supports text-to-image and text-based image editing for up to 14 images.
- Offers native 4K resolution, flexible and ultra-wide/tall aspect ratios (from 1:8 to 8:1).
- Multilingual on-image text rendering and camera-style prompt controls.
- Includes code examples, usage tips, detailed API parameters, and security guidance.
